spans.s:
r. 4th cl. (उ,) गृधु (गृध्यति)
To covet, to desire greedily, to be greedy.

m. (-धुः)
1 The deity KĀMA or love.
2 A libidinous man.
E.
गृध to desire, कु Uṇādi aff.

Air voided downwards.
3 Bad, wicked.
E.
गृध, and कू Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-ध्नुः-ध्नुः-ध्नु)
Covetous, cupidinous, greedy.
E.
गृध to be greedy, क्नु aff.

f. (-ता)
Covetousness, greediness, extreme and illiberal desire.
E.
गृध्नु greedy, and तल् abstract aff.

mfn. (-ध्रः-ध्रा-ध्रं)
Desirous, greedy, covetous.
m. (-घ्रः)
A vulture.
E.
गृध to desire, and क्रन् Uṇādi affix; it may also be written गृद्ध.

f. (-खी)
1 The jujube, (Zizyphus jujuba.)
2 A wild kind of the same, (Zizyphus nepeca.)
E.
गृध्र a vulture, and नख nail, having thorns like a vulture's claws.

m. (-जः)
A name of JAṬĀYU.
E.
गृध्र, and राज king.

Rheumatism affecting the loins.
E.
गृध desire, सो to destroy, ड and ङीप् affixes; also sometimes written ग्रध्रसी.
